ideas.name: with the 200-session average (bull market longs, bear shorts)
ideas.why: the long trend's investors buy dips and breakouts its way; against it rallies are sold

ideas.name: with the 50-session average
ideas.why: the medium trend: funds rebalancing to it add to breakouts its way

ideas.name: with last week (its close over the week before's)
ideas.why: weekly momentum: the week's buyers keep buying the next week's breakouts

ideas.name: with the month so far (above the month's open, long)
ideas.why: month-to-date winners attract the month's flows

ideas.name: with yesterday's candle (its close over its open, long)
ideas.why: yesterday's direction carries into today's first moves

ideas.name: today's VWAP above yesterday's final VWAP (long)
ideas.why: the average price rising day over day is value moving up: breakouts with value run

ideas.name: opened beyond yesterday's range its way
ideas.why: an open outside yesterday's range is a day of imbalance: initiative, not rotation

ideas.name: the 50-session average above the 200 (long) / below (short)
ideas.why: the golden-cross regime: trend funds are positioned its way
